test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The new shop that opened last week __are hardly__ sufficient stock of the products that it advertised about.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'hardly had.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The error lies in Part (are hardly) of the sentence.
 
• As per instructions, the remaining portion of the sentence is correct.
 
• As the given sentence mentions **'last week'** therefore the sentence should be in **the past tense.** From the given options we can deduce that the sentence will be in **the past perfect tense. **
 
• The structure of the past perfect tense:** Subject+ had+ V3+ object.**
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• ***​**The actors **hardly had** time to learn their lines before filming started.*
 
 
 
• We know that the word **'hardly'** expresses a negative sense, therefore we need to use the positive form of the helping verb **'had.'**
 
• Therefore, in the erroneous part, the use of 'are hardly' in the sentence should be replaced with 'hardly had' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence:__ *The new shop that opened last week **__hardly had__**** **sufficient stock of the products that it advertised about.*
